summary: Ten-League International Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting it regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule after receiving a delisting determination. The company had been notified on September 9, 2025 of non-compliance and received a delisting notice on March 10, 2026. After a hearing on April 16, 2026, the Panel granted continued listing conditional on demonstrating compliance by May 15, 2026. On May 26, 2026, Nasdaq confirmed compliance, subject to a Mandatory Panel Monitor through May 26, 2027. During the monitor period, failure to maintain compliance will result in immediate delisting without grace period. Watch for any future bid price dip triggering delisting.
